name: University of Chittagong
about: The University of Chittagong is a public research university that opened on 18 November 1966. Its hilly 2312.32-acre campus lies in mauja Fatehpur, Hathazari upazila, about 22 km north of Chattogram city. It has 10 faculties with 51 departments and 4 institutes.
